name: entry_filter_v1_create_only
what: entry_filter_v1 (G1 rule 3, gradient-boosted trees depth 3, P(take-profit) of the LEAD) re-fitted on the create-time features only: no bundle-run features (they stream in after the decision); rule: skip if score < t1 (bottom training tertile)

dropped.metadata JSON (m_*, meta_ok): fetched ~450 ms after the create (p50), after the slot-0 decision
dropped.cu_used: an execution result (meta.computeUnitsConsumed), not in the shred
dropped.name / symbol text (name_len .. name_dig: Unicode-table definitions (isalpha, CJK names) not reproducible bit for bit outside Python; AUC 0.53-0.59 alone (G1 ablation)
dropped.op_g1_prior_log: counts creates in the 1.27 % gap-1 sample; a live bot has no such sample
dropped.op_busy: needs 15 minutes of trades after each launch; the live store is written 10 s after each launch
dropped.bundle run (nB .. tok_pct_insiders, 17 f: the creation slot's bundle run behind the create streams in after the decision (feed_bundle); only the create transaction is known when the hot loop fires

new_features.intx_n_buys: number of pump.fun buy instructions inside the create transaction (0 when none); predictor.create_tx_features

tertiles.protocol: weighted 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles of the in-sample predictions on the random-sample rows (operator-pool and HA-armed rows excluded), as in G1's freeze (predictor_wf.freeze)

full_bundle_blanked.note: full model, bundle features set to 0 at scoring (fit unchanged)

create_only_minus_full.note: paired difference of the skip-bottom-tertile lifts on the same 480 launches
